tools.name: status
tools.title: Status
tools.description: Read the Mac's KVM and sitter state: whether the KVM is reached, what the video and keyboard show, and the sitter's state. Changes nothing.

report.description: The status as one JSON object: name, kvm, sitter and sitter_via.

tools.name: look
tools.title: Look
tools.description: Take one look at the Mac's screen through its KVM and report what the sitter sees. Changes nothing.

look.description: The look as one JSON object: the screen's state and the sitter's reading.
